coordinate_contract.historical_record_requirement: independently verified source/hash bindings, actor-root poses, and root-local scoring-center offsets for cube and bowl
coordinate_contract.reset: actor-root position plus quaternion; <=3 mm and <=2 degrees
coordinate_contract.scoring: geometric center reconstructed from root pose plus measured root-local offset

coverage_policy: This initial gate is diagnostic-only. A supplied registry is not proof that all historical layouts were supplied, so it never authorizes release.
missing_evidence: No hash-bound historical LAT actor-root/scoring-center layout registry was supplied.
